mod_help_desc: help command. Help function via discord message. Contains all available commands.
mod_music_desc:
Music module optimized for direct playback from YouTube.

Command list:
• !play [search or URL]: Searches and plays a song.
• !stop: Stops everything and clears the queue.
• !skip: Skips the current song.
• !pause / !resume: Pauses or resumes playback.
• !list: Shows the current queue.
• !shuffle: Shuffles the songs in the queue randomly.
• !leave: Disconnects the bot from the voice channel.
• !next [search or URL]: Inserts a song at the beginning of the queue.
• !playlist / !pls: Loads the specially configured playlist.
mod_ai_desc:
The brain of the bot. Reads conversations passively to learn, but ONLY responds to direct mentions.

Subprocesses (can be turned off):
- Chat: Generates responses. If turned off, the bot reads but becomes mute.
- Emotion Analysis: Changes the bot's mood based on the chat. If turned off, its attitude freezes.
- Memory Learning: Saves biographical data and user opinions.
- Multimodal and Web: Capable of seeing images sent to chat and searching the internet (!ask).
- Voice: Can speak via TTS (!voice) and listen to microphones (!talk).

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Requires a Google AI Studio API Key configured in the 'Credentials' tab.

Recommendation: Write in the second person (e.g., 'You are an AI that...'). Be descriptive but concise.

ai_moods_help_current:
ℹ Current AI state.
Format: [Mood]: [Thought/Description]
Ex: Irritated: This guy is unbearable.
ai_moods_help_possible:
ℹ Format: [Mood]: [Description]
The description defines how the AI should behave under that state. It is recommended to add instructions matching the desired personality.
For example, if you want it to say, do, or use a particular vocabulary under a certain state, it must be specified in the description.

ai_prompts_warn_desc:
These prompts are the logical core of the AI subprocesses.
It is not recommended to edit the analysis instructions unless you know exactly what you are doing.
NEVER delete or modify the variables in braces (e.g., {mensajes}, {identidad}), or the bot will fail and crash.

• ID: Unique Discord Identifier (Not editable).
• Name: Display name or nickname of the user.
• Base Role: Authority level (e.g., User, Parent / Admin, Friend, Enemy, etc).
• Relationship / Description: Context about who they are and how the AI should treat them.

Recommendation: Write timeless facts in the third person (e.g., 'Lives in Spain', 'Likes rock').

ℹ Here you can manage the affinity and relationship with known users.
Keep in mind that it is constantly updated.

guide_discord_text:
STEP 1: CREATE THE APPLICATION
1. Go to: https://discord.com/developers/applications
2. Log in and click on "New Application".
3. Name your bot and accept.

STEP 2: CONFIGURE THE BOT
1. In the left menu, go to "Bot".
2. Enable the 3 "Privileged Gateway Intents":
   [X] PRESENCE INTENT
   [X] SERVER MEMBERS INTENT
   [X] MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT
3. Save changes.

STEP 3: GET THE TOKEN
1. Above, in the same "Bot" tab, look for the "Reset Token" button.
2. Copy it. THAT IS YOUR DISCORD_TOKEN.
3. Paste it in the corresponding field in this Launcher.

STEP 4: INVITE THE BOT TO YOUR SERVER
1. In the left menu, go to "OAuth2" -> "URL Generator".
2. Under "Scopes", check "bot".
3. Below, under "Bot Permissions", check "Administrator".
4. Copy the "Generated URL" below, paste it into your browser and authorize the bot on your server.
guide_google_text:
STEP 1: ACCESS GOOGLE AI STUDIO
1. Go to: https://aistudio.google.com/
2. Log in with your Google account.

STEP 2: CREATE THE API KEY
1. Look for the "Get API key" button (or in the left menu).
2. Click on "Create API key in new project".
3. Copy the generated key. THAT IS YOUR GEMINI_API_KEY.
4. Paste it in the corresponding field in this Launcher.

TIP:
- If the AI bot stops responding and the console says "Error 429", it means you exhausted your free quota.
- Solution: Create another API Key (with another Google account if necessary) and paste it into the "Google AI Key (Backup)" field. The bot will switch to the second key automatically.
guide_id_text:
STEP 1: ENABLE DEVELOPER MODE
1. Open Discord and go to "User Settings" (gear icon).
2. In the left menu, scroll down to "Advanced".
3. Turn on the "Developer Mode" switch.

STEP 2: COPY USER ID (ADMIN_ID)
1. Right-click on your own name or avatar (in any chat or member list).
2. Click on "Copy User ID".
3. Paste that number in the "Admin ID" field.

STEP 3: COPY CHANNEL ID (WELCOME_CHANNEL_ID)
1. Right-click on the name of the text channel where you want the bot to greet.
2. Click on "Copy Channel ID".
3. Paste that number in the "Welcome Channel ID" field.
guide_privacy_text:
====================================================================
           HOW MEOWSICK HANDLES YOUR SERVER'S DATA
====================================================================

Specifically the AI module (can be completely disabled in the Modules window)

1. LOCAL STORAGE (100% Private)
All of the bot's "memory" files (opinions, facts, known users, personality, and moods) are strictly saved on your computer (in local JSON files). None of this is uploaded to third-party databases. You have absolute control.

2. CLOUD PROCESSING (Google Gemini)
For the bot to "think", see images, or listen to audio, it uses Google's API. This means that every time the bot reads a message in Discord, it packages and sends to Google's servers:
  - The latest chat messages (History for context).
  - Images sent in the chat (Vision).
  - Audio recorded via microphone (Voice).
  - A summary of the memory of the user talking to it.

3. GOOGLE TERMS AND PRECAUTIONS ⚠️
When using Google AI Studio's free tier, Google's policies state that the data sent to their API MAY be processed and read by human reviewers to train their future Artificial Intelligence models.
Therefore, NEVER share passwords, bank details, exact addresses, or highly sensitive personal information in the channels where the AI is operating.

4. HOW TO PROTECT MY SERVER'S USERS?
Use the "Channel Whitelist (IDs)" option in the [AI Settings > Filters] tab of the Launcher. If you place a specific channel ID there (Ex: #chat-with-ai), the bot will become completely "deaf" and ignore the rest of the server's channels, guaranteeing total privacy in your other spaces.

5. DEVELOPER'S RECOMMENDATION (Zero-Data-Retention)
I strongly recommend using the Local AI engine (Ollama/Gemma) once it is configured. Under the zero-data-retention principle, you guarantee absolute privacy since NOTHING will leave your machine to the internet.

6. LEGAL DISCLAIMER
The original developer DOES NOT collect, monitor, or have access to any data, token, or history processed by this bot. Each instance is 100% isolated. I completely disclaim any liability for any misuse or malicious use of the application. Its download, execution, and moderation are the sole responsibility of the end user.
guide_local_text:
STEP 1: INSTALL OLLAMA
1. Go to the official page: https://ollama.com/
2. Download the installer for your operating system.
3. Run the installer and follow the default steps.
4. Once installed, Ollama will run silently in the background on your PC.

STEP 2: DOWNLOAD THE AI BRAIN
1. In MeowSick, go to the AI Engines > Local tab.
2. Click on "Install / Update Local AI".
3. A black terminal will open downloading the neural weights (between 2GB and 8GB depending on the model).
4. Wait for the download to finish at 100% and close the black terminal.

STEP 3: MODEL REQUIREMENTS
- Gemma 3 (4B): Requires approx 4GB to 6GB of Video Memory (VRAM). Ideal for mid-range PCs.
- Gemma 3 (12B): Requires 12GB+ of VRAM. Smarter, requires high-end.
- If you notice your PC gets very slow, try a smaller model or use Cloud.

WHAT IS THE ENDPOINT?
It is the network address where your PC communicates with Ollama. By default it is always: http://localhost:11434
